_businessName_note: The practice name — the site title, the nav lockup, og:site_name and the JSON-LD MedicalBusiness name all come from here. It must stay byte-identical to the Google Business Profile listing: conflicting name signals actively reduce confidence in the listing. Confirm with Julia before launch.
name: Julia Comstock-Ross
_url_note: PLACEHOLDER — replace with the real domain before launch. Used for canonical, OG and sitemap URLs.
_contact_note: phoneHref should be the tel: digits, e.g. +13605551234. Left empty until the real number exists so no broken tel link ships.
_image_note: Both null until real assets exist. ogImage should be a 1200x630 PNG at /assets/img/og-default.png; appleTouchIcon a 180x180 PNG. A broken og:image is worse than none, so the tags are only emitted once these are set.

_services_note: Consulting unit is unconfirmed — currently '$150 / session' on the live site with no duration, sitting beside '$150 / hour' for OT. Needs a real duration.
